description: Weekloop connects ChatGPT to your private marketing workspace so you can review business context, Spark ideas, weekly plans, generated content, and production status in one conversation. You can create and revise private drafts, record approvals or revision decisions, and (after explicit confirmation) start production for approved content. Publishing, scheduling, messaging, payments, and subscription purchases remain outside ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Show my Weekloop account and available credits.
Show my latest generated content and open the newest Instagram draft.
Draft an Instagram plan for next week. Show it to me first and do not save anything yet.
